result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores in the United States, **I'd recommend Stripe as the best all-around payment processor**, with PayPal offered as an additional checkout option.

However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses and how much you're selling.

## My top 5 recommendations

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and many ecommerce platforms
- Excellent fraud prevention and subscription tools

Website: [Stripe](https://stripe.com)

---

![PayPal Data Engineer Interview Guide: Process, Tips & Sample Questions (2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/f0uRaTYwCkNonVHhCf9KOTEsVnKlm9vvkNkLP-NC6CJKaxFB8F1HmrcbukmpLY611LX5Y93PEbagy1tQey-5apWDqbD9c6blP1TQ7MwEmDOj_cRP3s85_4cgV3W1x6Qbn1kdiUTQ0O5_78RzJpDEHd1ZeXSgH84eTY8Jums_ROnoO0E03vBGeB5VkqESBnwA?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Widely recognized by online shoppers
- Offers PayPal and other payment options
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms
- Transaction fees vary by checkout method

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify
- No separate payment gateway needed
- Simplifies refunds and order management
- Processing rates depend on your Shopify plan

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great for businesses selling online and in person
- Website and inventory tools
- Free starting plan
- Online processing fees depend on plan

Website: [Square](https://squareup.com)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Potentially attractive for growing businesses
- Worth comparing when processing substantial monthly sales

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com)

US pricing examples; actual fees vary by transaction type, plan, card and other factors. ## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Just starting out | Stripe |
| Already using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Want customers to use PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Sell online and in person | Square |
| Growing sales volume | Compare Helcim |
